summary: The maintained image helper owns a closed sc2-headless profile through one internal module, sharing command capture, journal and OCI validation rather than a separate launcher. Exact helper/product/source/support/configuration objects and externally selected private product pins are hash-bound before effects; selected correspondence is not operation authority. One original boot/monotonic work interval plus retirement aperture applies across commands, hash scans, sampling and cleanup without phase renewal. Combined raw output and retained metadata are bounded across the operation. Direct-child kernel birth, namespace observation, stream EOF and wait are independent facts: short-child namespace loss is retained as an observation gap, and leader exit does not prove pipe or descendant settlement. Only retained direct birth permits signalling; native censuses do not authorize foreign removal. Shared-host reservations and independent enclosing-cgroup headroom are separately admitted, while sampled affinity/RSS/disk policies do not establish hard containment. Disk population includes allocation context/build/export/evidence and the disjoint load store once. Streaming OCI validation bounds headers, extensions, expanded bytes and virtual path memory, discards tar member caches, and checks regular source evidence before verified same-object load. The SC2-only FIFO exception is exact zero-content CLR debug metadata; it never opens or extracts a FIFO, and aliases, FIFO hardlink targets and nonregular required evidence refuse. Other profiles retain their type policy. Actual-caller synthetic controls cover the shared capture, original lifetime, resource refusals, source substitutions, native dependency gates, OCI replacements and first-cause cleanup. Source controls do not qualify current engines, namespaces, image fit, product behavior, whole-descendant cleanup or worker-loss containment. Native operation remains separately admitted and qualified; restricted product/evidence identities stay outside public source and records.
title: Keep the closed SC2 image operation inside the maintained image controller
